nodes.label: Provider-Neutral AI
nodes.rationale: OpenRouter primary, Ollama fallback, swap via config. Avoids vendor lock-in and enables fully local demo mode.

nodes.label: Telegram Deep Link Account Linking
nodes.rationale: One-time link token via /start?token=<link_token> binds the Telegram account to the web user identity on first bot contact.

nodes.label: pgvector Exact Search
nodes.rationale: No HNSW until scale demands it; exact search keeps MVP simple and correct.

nodes.label: 3-State Eligibility
nodes.rationale: ELIGIBLE / INELIGIBLE / UNKNOWN; never silently drop ambiguous cases so unknowns stay visible instead of becoming false negatives.

nodes.label: Domain Code Isolation
nodes.rationale: Domain code must not import FastAPI, Celery/arq, LangGraph, or provider SDKs; keeps business logic portable and testable.

nodes.label: Bounded Agent Budgets
nodes.rationale: Hard budgets on steps, LLM calls, runtime; budget exhaustion is terminal. Guarantees predictable cost and termination for every agent run.

nodes.label: Deterministic-First Principle
nodes.rationale: Regex/rule parsers run before LLM; LLM only for semantic ambiguity. Cuts cost and latency.

nodes.label: Bounded Agent Runs Rule
nodes.rationale: All agent runs are bounded in steps, LLM calls, runtime.

nodes.label: Default-Deny Tools
nodes.rationale: Tool permissions are default-deny per agent; explicit grants only, reducing blast radius of agent mistakes.

nodes.label: Deterministic Logic First Rule
nodes.rationale: Deterministic logic first, LLM only when reasoning is needed.

nodes.label: No Direct DB Access For Agents
nodes.norm_label: no direct db access for agents
nodes.rationale: Agents never touch the database directly; module services centralize access control and auditing.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Services-First Agent Deferral
nodes.rationale: Wiring all four remaining agent graphs at once would delay delivery of real scraped data without changing user-visible behavior, since services already implement identical logic. Deferral is temporary and must not become permanent; later wiring is conformance, not change (no new ADR needed). Accepted risk: agent_runs analytics under-report recommendation/feedback until wiring completes.
